name: Address Autocomplete by GeoScale
author: GeoScale

sections.description:
GeoScale adds address autocomplete to WooCommerce checkout, helping customers enter addresses faster and reducing
address errors.

As a customer types a billing or shipping address, GeoScale provides matching suggestions. Selecting a suggestion
automatically fills the relevant WooCommerce address fields.

GeoScale currently supports:

  • Netherlands
  • Belgium
  • Luxembourg
  • Germany
  • Austria
  • Switzerland
  • France

The plugin works with both the WooCommerce Checkout Block and classic shortcode checkout.

A GeoScale account with an active subscription and API key is required. The plugin is open source, while the GeoScale
Address API is a separate usage-based paid service.

For pricing and more information, visit GeoScale.

External Services

This plugin connects to the GeoScale Address API at api.geoscale.io to provide address autocomplete.

When a customer uses address autocomplete during WooCommerce checkout, the plugin sends the following information to
GeoScale:

  • Address search text entered by the customer
  • Selected checkout country
  • Customer’s browser language
  • GeoScale address identifier when a suggestion is selected

The store’s GeoScale API key is sent with API requests for authentication. The API key is transmitted server-to-server
and is not exposed to the customer’s browser.

This information is sent only when address autocomplete is used and is necessary to provide address suggestions and
retrieve selected addresses.

GeoScale: https://www.geoscale.io/

Terms of Service: https://www.geoscale.io/en/legal/terms

Privacy Policy: https://www.geoscale.io/en/legal/privacy

Source Code

Human-readable source code for the compiled JavaScript in public/js/index.js is included in src/index.js.

The JavaScript can be built using the configuration in package.json:

npm install

npm run build
sections.installation:
Before installing the plugin, you need a GeoScale account with an active subscription and API key.

To get an API key:

  1. Sign up for GeoScale if you haven’t already.
  2. Go to Billing and choose Add subscription.
  3. Go to API keys and click Create API key.

To install and configure the plugin:

  1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add Plugin.
  2. Search for Address Autocomplete by GeoScale.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > General.
  5. Find Address autocomplete and enable Predictive address search.
  6. Enter your API key in the GeoScale API key field directly below it.
  7. Save your changes.

GeoScale is now ready to provide address suggestions during checkout for supported countries.
sections.faq:
Which countries are supported?

GeoScale supports address autocomplete for the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and
France.

Do I need a GeoScale account?

Yes. A GeoScale account with an active subscription and API key is required to use the address autocomplete service.

Does it work with both WooCommerce checkout types?

Yes. GeoScale supports both the WooCommerce Checkout Block and classic shortcode checkout.

What happens if the GeoScale service is unavailable?

Customers can continue entering their address manually if address autocomplete is unavailable.
